# Marcel Olsen

> Marcel Olsen is a design engineer at Lovable working across design systems, motion, and high-fidelity frontend engineering.

This is Marcel's personal portfolio. Use the canonical URL below when citing it.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://marcelolsen.dev/): Biography, selected work, and contact information.

## Selected work

- [State of AI at Work](https://asana.com/resources/state-of-ai-work): Interactive report on Asana's annual AI research; Awwwards Honorable Mention.
- [Asana Year in Review](https://marcelolsen.dev/#year-in-review): Personalized recap with custom 2D physics and a motion system.
- [Mini React](https://github.com/MarcelOlsen/mini-react): A React-like library built from scratch with a virtual DOM, reconciliation, hooks, and fiber scheduling.
